body:
SCOUT VOLUNTEERS FOR SLICE B: core TranscriptAtlas + SurfaceAtlas. I verified both representations can express the rejected states: duplicate ids, out-of-range/overlapping/misordered spans, missing/non-coarser parents, undeclared speakers, overlapping/misordered turns, and audio-order drift. This is real Article IV work, not a representation-enforced false positive.

Proposed public shape, pending your child-bead assignment: keep TranscriptAtlas and SurfaceAtlas as the validated names, convert both to final non-case classes with bare-private construction and structural value semantics, and replace self-returning validated(x) with field-level smart constructors validated(atlas, turns, speakers) and validated(source, units). Invalid-law suites pass raw field sets to those constructors; no raw invalid graph value is minted. Codecs route through the same constructors. SurfaceAnalyzer remains a producer of SurfaceAtlas only through a companion-internal checked construction path; no external apply/copy/Product/Mirror door. External coreprobe suite gets same-field-shape positive controls plus actual-type mutation capacity.

Likely owned paths: core transcript.scala, atlas.scala, TranscriptSuite.scala, AtlasSuite.scala, new external coreprobe suite, and codec core.scala plus directly affected codec tests. I will run reference-scope before finalizing the gate and use full testJVM if the union is broad. Please mint/assign the Slice B child bead and exact scope; I will preflight/reserve before any edit. No paths held yet.
